scope: Qualitative review of old Step-constrained outputs; not a review of new natural-prompt generation.
sampling: Per question: first paragraph, upper-middle paragraph and second-to-last; all paragraphs if only two. Blank-line or real Thinking-close terminated paragraphs included; incomplete truncated tails excluded. This review has 341 paragraphs in its pool, while check.py intentionally counts only 336 real blank-line terminated paragraphs.
limits: Assistant review is not independent human labeling.
Mathematical-looking content does not imply one complete step or correct reasoning.
Currency dollar signs can trigger false-positive open-math flags.

examples.note: Format-only paragraph ends: The prompt asks to write "Step 1:", "Step 2:", etc. Okay.
35,703 characters of repeated calculations in one paragraph; sparse checkpoint coverage.
